title: Groundhog: reliability of tool-using agents on medical-evidence tasks (v1.2.0)
description: Benchmark of 50 verified medical-evidence tasks for tool-using AI agents, with frozen tool responses, fault injection, scorers (outcome, process, pass^k), a calibrated model judge, a failure taxonomy and an item analysis. v1.2.0 adds Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash called through Google's own API (five models, 2,510 scored runs) and replicates the v1.1 planted-instruction finding on Gemini 3.1 Pro directly. Code MIT; task files CC BY 4.0.
